name: steam-turbine
description: Industrial Steam Turbine Simulation — FrankenSim convergence-kernel multiphysics (IAPWS-IF97 steam, Colburn-Hougen condensation, 4-DOF gyroscopic rotordynamics, PHS synchronous generator, AxisymmetricChart & NurbsSurface geometry, 48 kHz acoustics).

scripts.build:cf: tsc --noEmit && vite build --base /turbine/ --outDir dist-cf/turbine --emptyOutDir && cp cloudflare/_headers dist-cf/_headers && cp cloudflare/.assetsignore dist-cf/.assetsignore
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:cf && npx wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.wasm: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${RCH_TARGET_BASE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/rch_target_frankensim_turbine /Users/jemanuel/.cargo/bin/cargo lbuild --offline --manifest-path engine-turbine/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release -j 4 && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm-pkg ${RCH_TARGET_BASE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/rch_target_frankensim_turbine/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fs_steam_turbine.wasm
